long_biography.plain_text:
Creating the Galápagos Conservation Fund gave tourism operator Federico “Fiddi” Angermeyer a way to link passenger revenue with protection of the islands’ marine environment. Angermeyer Cruises partnered with WildAid to support surveillance, ranger training, biosecurity and efforts against illegal fishing and invasive species.

That conservation work reflects how Angermeyer designs travel around the archipelago. His itineraries draw on decades of captaining and guiding, using knowledge of currents and winds to structure small-group voyages. He has served on WildAid’s international board and received its Wildlife Champion honour for incorporating environmental protection into Galápagos tourism.
